messages:
emma: Hey team — quick sync about the weekly engineering triage call. Proposal: move the recurring from Tue 3pm to Wed 9am (more overlap with APAC mornings) and tighten the agenda. Current pain: meeting runs long and owner handoffs are unclear. nate: Wed 9am works better for me. +1 for stricter timeboxes. anita: I'm fine with Wed. Can we make explicit owner rotation so the same people aren't always handling bug queue? lucas: Agree. Suggested agenda (40m total): ``` 1) Backlog grooming (15m) — pick 3 highest-priority tickets 2) Bug queue triage (15m) — assign owners & severity 3) Owner assignment / roll call (5m) 4) Quick blockers & follow-ups (5m) ``` If we keep strict timers we can finish in 40. rj: +1 on the agenda. Suggest we add a lightweight owners doc and rotate weekly by team (infra, runtime, platform, product). I can draft a starter list. emma: Perfect — rj pls add the owners doc and I'll update the calendar invite. Also propose this small tweak: for any bug marked P0/P1, owner must post a one-line status in the triage thread after the meeting. anita: That'll help with async visibility. Also can we add a short "blocked until" tag on tickets so we know what's waiting on external input? lucas: +1. Also propose an optional deep-dive slot once a month for RFC/design reviews (30m) instead of regular triage; we can skip if nothing queued. emma: Good call — monthly design review slot added as "first Wed of month" when needed. calendar-bot: Event updated: "Engineering Weekly Triage" recurring Wed 09:00-09:40 (PDT) — https://calendar.company/evt/abcd1234 :calendar: nate: Small ask — can we include a meeting doc template in the invite with the agenda and links to backlog and bug board? Makes it easier to prep. rj: On it. I'll create a template in Google Docs and share in the invite. Will also paste a rotating owners table:
`Week 1: infra (anita), runtime (lucas), product (emma)` etc. emma: Thanks all. Action items: rj -> owners doc + template, emma -> update invite/description, calendar-bot -> send updated invite to eng-all. We'll start Wed this week. If anyone can't make the first week ping here and we'll swap. :thumbsup:
